title: scheduler.v1 gRPC over unix sockets: Executor.Run(verb, args, idempotency key, timeout) and Executor.Health; Scheduler.Health, Status, Reload and Drain
text: The control plane between the scheduler container and the host executor, defined in SPEC-16.H. Revised 2026-10-13 (card C15): it was decided_by DEC-nats-jetstream-grpc, whose bus is deferred; the gRPC half of that decision is the part that landed (scheduler/api/scheduler/v1/scheduler.proto), so the edge now points at DEC-scheduler-two-processes, which owns the split and the socket.
